_approach: Modelled on Folamour's habit of starting a loop low in the mix and letting it 'rear up': bar 1 is a stripped clap-and-kick groove, bar 2 adds a second clap layer and denser swung hats and shaker without changing the underlying pattern -- the same loop, more energy. MPC swing 58% (engine 0.16). Reference: Folamour 'Cathédrale', 'Movement Therapy'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
